may2026.role: weights used by the July 2026 lab run

aug2026.role: current posting; corrects HWGT and FYWGT

conventions.error_dollars: sum(HWGT * AMTERR); the FY file pools 12 monthly samples, so the sum is annual
conventions.code_class: a case counts if any of AGENCY1-AGENCY9 is in the class (classes overlap)
conventions.solver_moved_input: any replayed input (rawusize, rawearn, rawunearn, rawrent, rawutil, rawmedded, rawdepded, rawcsded) differs from its file field (FSUSIZE, FSEARN, FSUNEARN, RENT, UTIL, FSMEDDED, FSDEPDED, FSCSDED; missing -> 0)
conventions.computation_candidate: not reproduced, and a finding carrying a code in [10, 17, 19, 20, 21, 22] is computational under the layer-2 rule
conventions.points_of_official_fy2024_rate: share of file error dollars x 9.97; an approximation, since the official rate is regression-adjusted and counts only errors above the $56 threshold
